name: Costa Coffee
observations: Two-storey red-brick building with prominent paired/stepped gable roof silhouette.
Long burgundy fascia carries large light COSTA COFFEE lettering.
Broad upper white-framed windows with many small divisions sit below gables.
Burgundy projecting awning shades lower glazed frontage; lower patio has low brick wall, seating/planters.
Narrow iron-gated passage separates Costa from Josiah Hincks side.
Passing lorry covers some angles; primary233/245 give better sign and awning evidence.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
